name: @docren/react-native-markdown-bench
description: Benchmarks and evidence scripts for the v1 rewrite (docs/rewrite: 02-benchmarks, 08-model-and-api, phase-1/decisions P1-1). Private workspace, never published.

scripts.model:memory: for m in mdast tokens tree table; do node --expose-gc model.mjs 60 $m; done
scripts.profile: PROFILE_WARM=1 node ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config profile/jest.config.cjs --runInBand && PROFILE_MODE=jit node ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config profile/jest.config.cjs --runInBand
scripts.profile:jitless: PROFILE_WARM=1 node ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config profile/jest.config.cjs --runInBand && PROFILE_MODE=jitless PROFILE_REPS=10 node --jitless ../node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config profile/jest.config.cjs --runInBand
